Container.Name: Sideloop
Container.Overview: Keeps sideloaded iPhone and iPad apps signed with a free Apple ID and refreshes them over Wi-Fi. This amd64 image includes Sideloop, AltServer, Anisette, usbmuxd and netmuxd in one container. Pair an unlocked device over USB first, then keep the device on the same LAN for refreshes. Settings, apps, signing data, pairing records and Anisette identity persist in appdata. Uses the original application's host networking and privileged USB access.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ios iphone ipad sideload altserver anisette
Container.Requires: Intel/AMD 64-bit server, USB access for initial device pairing, same LAN as the device, internet access for Apple signing and a throwaway Apple ID. Host ports 8080 (web UI), 6969 (local Anisette) and 27015 (local device service) must be available.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persists apps, settings, signing data and Anisette identity. If you change this path, change Pairing Records to its lockdown subdirectory too.

Config.Name: Pairing Records
Config.Description: USB pairing records. Keep this inside Appdata so one backup covers all persistent data.

Config.Name: USB Devices
Config.Description: USB devices for initial iPhone/iPad pairing and USB installation.

Config.Name: Udev
Config.Description: Host device metadata used by usbmuxd.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for schedules and logs, for example America/New_York or Europe/London.

Config.Name: Device Connection Mode
Config.Description: Use the bundled USB and Wi-Fi connection services.

Config.Name: Anisette Server
Config.Description: Bundled Anisette service. No separate container is needed.
